primer: AvePoint (NASDAQ: AVPT) provides enterprise SaaS data governance, resilience, and AI trust for Microsoft 365, Salesforce, and Google Workspace. The platform protects more than 28,500 organizations across 14 sovereign Azure data centers worldwide. Annual recurring revenue reached $495.1 million in Q3 2026, growing 27% year over year with 90% gross retention and 111% net retention. The company generates strong cash flow, producing $81.6 million in Free Cash Flow in fiscal 2025 with zero debt and over $410 million in cash reserves.
